label: Manifest
comment: An ordered collection of entries: the examples a ShEx implementation offers, or the tests of a test suite.

label: Entry
comment: One validation and the outcome expected of it: a schema, the data to validate, and a query map (or one node and one shape) saying which nodes are validated against which shapes.

label: entries
comment: The entries of a manifest, in order.

label: name
comment: A name for the entry, unique within its manifest.

label: schema
comment: The entry's schema. A literal is the schema's text; an IRI (written with the term schemaURL) is the document that holds it.

label: schema label
comment: What to call the entry's schema when presenting it to a person. Entries with one schema usually share its label.

label: data
comment: The data the entry validates. A literal is the data's text; an IRI (written with the term dataURL) is the document that holds it. Several values are the documents of one graph.

label: data label
comment: What to call the entry's data when presenting it to a person.

label: query map
comment: The entry's query map, pairing node selectors with shapes. A literal is the map in ShapeMap syntax; an IRI (written with the term queryMapURL) is the document that holds it. An entry with one node and one shape may write them as shex:node and shex:shape instead.

label: query map label
comment: What to call the entry's query map when presenting it to a person.
What the entry shows or tests.
The shape an entry validates its node against; absent for the schema's start shape.
